title: JSON Forms config — core, antd and the extended renderer sets
description: A superset of jsonforms-config.schema.json, which it REFERENCES rather than restates: everything that file describes still applies here, and this file adds only what the framework-agnostic extended renderers and their antd bindings read. Nothing is duplicated, so the two cannot disagree.

allOf.description: Everything a host on core plus the antd renderer set can author.
What the extended renderer sets add, all of it inside the namespace.

extendedOnly.description: Options only the extended renderer sets read. The base file's own namespaced options still apply through the reference above; they are deliberately not repeated here.

defaultTemplateLang.description: Engine for a TemplateLayout that names none. The flat config.defaultTemplateLang is still honoured beneath this.

propagateErrors.description: Default for whether an embedded editor publishes its own diagnostics as an additional error. Off by default: finding a problem does not entitle a renderer to invalidate the form.

colorTextEntry.description: Default for whether the colour control offers text entry beside its picker.

rows.description: Default visible rows for an embedded editor.

monaco.description: Default options passed through to the code editor. Escape hatch: contents are the editor's own contract, not portable.

agGridOptions.description: Default options passed through to the data grid. Local arrays replace wholesale, including column definitions; option objects merge recursively.

colorSaveFormat.description: Stored serialization for the colour control, separate from the picker's internal model. A format that cannot carry transparency reports the loss rather than discarding it silently.

allowAdditionalPropertiesIfMissing.description: Offers the dynamic-property editor where the schema states no additionalProperties. Controls availability of the editor, not validation.

allowEmptyPropertyNames.description: Permits creating a property whose name is the empty string. Such a name has no addressable path and is edited through a path-free editor.

showBorder.description: Default for the tuple control's enclosing border.

showEmptyButton.description: Default for the composite detail dialog's Clear action.

showRemoveButton.description: Default for the composite detail dialog's Remove action.

table.description: Default for forcing the table presentation on an array whose items nest.

convertJson.description: Default for parsing an embedded editor's text as JSON before storing it.

security.description: Gates for the two escape hatches. Both default closed.

allowScriptEvaluation.description: Permits compiling a string script. Enabling it means the host treats the UI schema as trusted executable code, and may require a content-security-policy allowance. It does NOT gate a function-valued script, which needs no evaluation.

urlPolicy.description: Applied to every URL-bearing value: link targets, image sources including scope-resolved ones, and Markdown URLs.

allowedSchemes.description: Permitted URL schemes. Control characters are stripped before the scheme is read.

allowImageDataUrls.description: Permits data: URLs for images only, so the flag cannot open a data:text/html document. SVG data URLs stay blocked unless the host opts into an SVG-safe policy.

templateLang.description: Template engine. An unknown language is diagnosed, never interpreted as another engine.

markup.description: How text elements that ask for markup are rendered.

enabled.description: Whether Markdown is parsed at all. Defaults to TRUE, unlike the other extension gates: those gate something that executes, this gates a parser that cannot, and whose profile already excludes raw HTML, images and embedded content. A refused request reports itself and still shows the text.

profile.description: basic: paragraphs and line breaks, bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, links, and ordered and unordered lists. extended: those plus headings, blockquotes, tables and fenced code. Raw HTML and images are excluded from both and are gated independently.

typography.description: Whether rendered text is wrapped in the UI library's own text components, so it inherits the theme. Switchable because those components carry their own margins, which can fight a form's spacing. An element's own typography option overrides this.

dynamicValues.description: Whether values may be resolved out of the form's data and the host's context. Gates the data, item, config and context namespaces for both text interpolation and $dynamic.

enabled.description: Defaults closed, like the other section 12 gates. What it opens is a reader, not an evaluator of host code: an expression cannot call, assign or reach a prototype, so this is a data-exposure control rather than a script-execution one. Static textParams keep working while it is shut.
